Curated lists that group published contributions by cohort, institution, course kit, or
event. A collection never holds materials of its own — it points at contributions that
each live in exactly one canonical place.

To propose one, open a pull request adding a `<id>.yml` file here. See
[`../docs/maintenance.md`](../docs/maintenance.md).

## Assessment Tools and Rubric Practice

`assessment-tools` · topic · AWS-MLU Faculty Fellows 2026

Everything in the repository about drafting, grounding, and reviewing assessment — the two automated grading tools and the facilitated session on what makes a rubric worth grading against. Rubrics written in the mlu-rubric/1 format move between them unchanged.

| # | Contribution | Why it is here |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | [The Assignment Lifecycle — Quick Assessment Demo Session](../mlu/professional-student-development/mlu-000005-quick-assessment-demos) <br>`mlu-000005` | Why a rubric that rewards surface features misgrades a confidently wrong paper. |
| 2 | [Paper Autograder — Rubric-Based Draft Grading](../mlu/ml-ai-applications/mlu-000004-paper-autograder) <br>`mlu-000004` | Automates the grading demo from the session. |
| 3 | [Class Participation Scoring — Transcript to Draft Score](../mlu/ml-ai-applications/mlu-000003-participation-scoring) <br>`mlu-000003` | The same grounded-judgment idea applied to spoken participation. |

## AWS-MLU Faculty AI Sequence

`aws-mlu-faculty-sequence` · course-kit · AWS-MLU Faculty Fellows 2026

Four contributions meant to be taught in order. The first establishes where AI fits in a course, the second opens the hood and shows how it works, and the last two apply the same retrieval stack to real instructional work. They share one stack, so an instructor who runs the first finds the environment familiar in all of them.

| # | Contribution | Why it is here |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | [Curriculum Embedding Lab — Embed AI in Your Course](../mlu/professional-student-development/mlu-000001-curriculum-embedding-lab) <br>`mlu-000001` | Start here. Establishes where AI belongs before anything is built. |
| 2 | [Discipline-Specific AI Teaching Assistant — Seminar Lab](../mlu/professional-student-development/mlu-000002-discipline-assistant-seminar) <br>`mlu-000002` | Explains how grounding works. The only member that needs no AWS account. |
| 3 | [Class Participation Scoring — Transcript to Draft Score](../mlu/ml-ai-applications/mlu-000003-participation-scoring) <br>`mlu-000003` | First contribution that touches real student records. |
| 4 | [Paper Autograder — Rubric-Based Draft Grading](../mlu/ml-ai-applications/mlu-000004-paper-autograder) <br>`mlu-000004` | Sibling of the participation tool, applied to written work. |
